messages:
sara: Sparrow (prospect) wants to replace CompetitorX. Key asks: prompt parity, predictable token billing, SCIM, and signed SLA for pilot. Can someone run the POC?

ben: I can lead presales. Need their corpus + list of critical intents. Also confirm residency (they asked for us-east).

oliver: Ill do the infra and token analysis. Plan: replay 750 prompts side-by-side, produce token delta and a delta-summary. Expect ~2-6% variance but will confirm.

tanya: Security will handle the SQ. Immediate flag: they require exportable audit logs and KMS. Ask: hosted in us-east ok or do they need Private?

sara: They said hosted-us-east is fine for pilot. Pricing ask: migration credits + a 2-week pilot discount. Can finance approve a $4k credit?

ben: Finance usually greenlights small promo credits for pilots. I'll ping finance and loop back.

oliver: Note: streaming stop behavior differs vs CompetitorX; include client-side finalization snippet in runbook to avoid false positives.

poc-bot: POC created: sparrow-poc-3410012345. Staging keys issued, expire 48h.

sara: Great — smoke run Thurs 09:30 PT. Owners: ben (customer), oliver (tests), tanya (security). I'll send invite after finance confirms credits.
